note: *e falava no mesmo sentido*: *in idípsum* is deferred under D9 (HANDOFF 20). The stylist called it bureaucratic and asked *do mesmo modo*, which says manner, not direction.
*fez grande contra mim a rasteira*: heel-trip and betrayal in one word, and all three readers heard betrayal (D41). The stylist calls it colloquial. MS1932's *traição* is the option.
*que comia o meu pão*, held against two Latinist minors asking *os meus pães*: *comer o pão de alguém* is the idiom, and number is grammar (D2, D29).
*desde sempre e para todo o sempre*, the close of Book I (D41; 105:48 copies it). Two Latinist minors ask *de século em século*, the option.
